title: Refuse story-launch session file reads again in sub-second cases

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-413#story-launch-session-review-cases at 2cb8c5184553209cada79b1b9f404743279dc21b

Verdict: Confirmed missing test path (bounded to the examined checks).

Promise (validated from the caller's suggestion): a historical file read of a landed run is admitted only for that run's exact retained pair (baseline AND tree) and listed paths; otherwise 409 "The file or comparison does not belong to this captured run." The story's goal is the story-launch session refusal; the rewrite dropped the old Playwright case's landed-run mismatches (`tree: receipt.base`, `baseline: receipt.revision`, foreign path, oldPath, `../` path) as owned elsewhere. Of those, the foreign tree is no longer exercised by the examined checks.

Fault: dashboard/server/storyReviewHistoricalFileAdmission.ts, admitLandedRun - removed the `file.tree !== review.tree ||` condition (one line). Fixtures and assertions untouched.

Maintained checks examined (Vitest, dashboard/backend.vitest.config.mts):
- dashboard/backend-tests/review/ad-hoc-review-file.spec.ts - reaches admitLandedRun (session-addressed landed run via storyReviewSessionFileAdmission.ts) with foreign path, foreign baseline ("a foreign comparison") and another session's reference; no foreign-tree case.
- dashboard/backend-tests/review/story-review-one-shot-admission.spec.ts - session refusal and reviewedLandedRunByReference only; does not reach admitLandedRun's pair check.
- Inspected, not run: story-review-completed-file-admission.spec.ts covers the Published-completion path (admitPublishedCompletion), not admitLandedRun; one-shot-landing-capture-admission.spec.ts and story-review-file-text-admission.spec.ts cover capture and workspace admission. A grep for the captured-run refusal message finds only ad-hoc-review-file.spec.ts.

Runs (isolated detached worktree at the revision, npm ci, clean pre-probe status):
1. Baseline: 2 files, 12 tests passed.
2. Faulted: same command, 12/12 still passed.
   Independent witness (temporary scratch spec, same fixture shape as ad-hoc-review-file.spec.ts: makeMe.aSessionReviewRead.ofLandedAdHocSession on a base->result rename repo, readingFile {reference, baseline: base, tree: base, path: new.txt, oldPath: old.txt}, reviewedFileDiff): unfaulted it was refused 409 with the captured-run message (passed); faulted it answered {"kind":"diff","printed":""} instead of refusing (failed). Wrong behavior observed on the intended admitLandedRun path.
3. Restored: fault reverted by an EXIT trap, witness deleted, `git status --porcelain` empty, HEAD unchanged; same command 12/12 passed. Scratch worktree removed. The execution checkout was not edited (its pre-existing modification to .planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md is not from this probe).

Omitted transition: a landed run's file diff/text naming the run's baseline and a listed path but a foreign tree is refused 409 "...does not belong to this captured run." (formerly the old Playwright case's `{ ...file, tree: receipt.base }` row).

Next proof action: add a foreign-tree example to ad-hoc-review-file.spec.ts's refusal table (e.g. `({ base }) => ({ tree: base })`), which reaches the same admitLandedRun. This is a new repair suggestion arising from the probe; no prior disposition matched. Repair and routing stay with the caller.

Costs:
- Test runtime (measured, Vitest-reported Duration): baseline 2.63 s, faulted maintained 1.40 s, restored 1.22 s; witness runs each about 1-2 s (wall, not separately captured). Excludes npm ci.
- Human effort: unavailable - no human participated in the probe.
- Agent effort: unavailable - no separately supported token or turn measure is exposed to this agent.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 86785 ms (measured), from 1795155330562 to 1795155417347 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: repaired within this story at f9834f6c3c85ee8bdcad59c85ec38d5ed15d4767 — a standalone foreign-tree example in dashboard/backend-tests/review/ad-hoc-review-file.spec.ts, which fails with the tree comparison removed and passes restored; no follow-up.
